mesh.title: Meshes
mesh.enabled_tip: Lossless cleanup: merges duplicate vertices (weld), reorders indices for GPU cache efficiency, removes unused/duplicate data, and folds flat-color textures into material colors. Output loads in every runtime.

textures.title: Textures
textures.compress_tip: Resizes each texture to its per-type max size and re-encodes it. PNG is recompressed losslessly (no quality loss); JPEG/WebP use the Quality slider.
textures.dedup_tip: Finds textures with identical pixels (SHA-256) and points every model at a single shared copy. Biggest win when the same texture is reused across many models.
textures.externalize_tip: Pulls textures out of the GLB into shared files under assets/optimized-textures/, so a shared texture downloads once instead of per-model. Required for cross-model dedup; these files deploy with your scene.
textures.format_tip: Output image format. PNG is lossless (recommended). JPEG and WebP are smaller but lossy and use the Quality slider.
textures.quality_tip: Encoding quality for JPEG/WebP (1–100). Higher keeps more detail at a larger file size. Ignored for PNG.
textures.sizes_tip: Maximum height in pixels per texture type; anything taller is downscaled proportionally. Base color and normal maps usually need more resolution than ORM or emissive.
